name: ID
meaning: The product's prefix, and the start of every ID under it.

name: Title
meaning: The product's name.

name: Actors
meaning: The roles its use cases name, separated by spaces.

name: Icon and color
meaning: How the app's space rail shows it.
type: An icon name and a color, or none.

name: Records
meaning: Every record under it, each with an ID, kind, title, parent, header fields, links and body.

name: Mentions
meaning: For each record, the existing records its body cites by ID, in order.

name: Config
meaning: The product's settings file.

name: Folders
meaning: Where its specs, checks and meta-model extension are.
type: Folder paths, relative to the root.

name: ID prefixes
meaning: Extra prefixes its prose cites.

name: Max children
meaning: The most children of one kind a record may hold.
type: Whole number, at least 1; 15 by default.

name: Extension rows
meaning: Rows in its extension's kinds, relations, sections and ids files, in the default files' columns.

name: Effect
meaning: What each row does to the defaults.
type: Derived: adds, or widens or changes a default with the same name.
example: Widens pattern_rule to ask for design

name: Name
meaning: The role, as an actor names it.

name: What it does
meaning: What a person or tool in this role does with the product, said in the product's body.
example: Lends tools and records their return.

name: ID
meaning: The product prefix and the domain's code.

name: Title
meaning: The capability, in the business's words.

name: Follows
meaning: Patterns the whole domain follows.

name: ID
meaning: The domain's ID and the capability's number.

name: Title
meaning: What the slice does.

name: Order
meaning: Its place in the domain.
type: Whole number, unique in the domain.

name: ID
meaning: The domain's ID and the aggregate's number.

name: Title
meaning: The record the aggregate is named for.

name: Relates to
meaning: Other aggregates it refers to by ID.

name: Field
meaning: The field's name, used once in the table.

name: Meaning
meaning: What the field means in the business.
example: The last day of the loan, in the library's time zone.

name: Kind of value
meaning: What sort of value the field holds, without storage types.
example: Date: the borrow date in the library's time zone plus 14 days.

name: Example
meaning: A value from the one case the domain's examples follow.

name: ID
meaning: The domain's ID and the entity's number.

name: Role
meaning: Whether it is the aggregate's root or a part.

name: Has one, has many, refers to
meaning: Its links to other entities, drawn as the ERD's edges.

name: ID
meaning: The domain's ID and the rule's number.

name: Title
meaning: The rule in a few words.
example: A tool that needs repair cannot be lent

name: Rule
meaning: The rule in full, with MUST, MUST NOT, SHOULD or MAY.
example: A tool marked for repair MUST NOT be lent.

name: ID
meaning: The domain's ID and the event's number.

name: Title
meaning: What happened, in the past tense.

name: Raised by
meaning: The entity of its aggregate whose change raises it, if any.

name: Reacted to by
meaning: The aggregates, use cases and components that react to it.

name: ID
meaning: The domain's ID and the use case's number.

name: Actor
meaning: The roles that carry it out.

name: Applies
meaning: The domain rules it relies on.

name: Follows
meaning: The patterns it follows, with a value for each of their settings.

name: ID
meaning: The use case's ID and the requirement's number.

name: Rule
meaning: The requirement in full.
example: A member MUST NOT borrow more than three tools at once.

name: ID
meaning: The product prefix, PAT and the pattern's name.

name: Settings
meaning: The field names each following use case gives.

name: ID
meaning: The pattern's ID and the rule's number.

name: Setting
meaning: The setting the rule depends on, if any.

name: Name
meaning: The field a following use case gives.
type: Text: a valid header field name.

name: Values
meaning: What each following use case gives, or Not applicable with a reason.

name: Layer
meaning: The layer's record.

name: Domain
meaning: The domain it belongs to, which its components belong to too.

name: Order
meaning: Its place in the domain.
type: Whole number, unique in the domain.

name: Title
meaning: What it holds.

name: Components
meaning: How many components it holds.

name: ID
meaning: The domain's ID and the component's number.

name: Type
meaning: What sort of code it is.

name: File
meaning: Where its code is, which may not exist yet.
type: File path under the product root.

name: Satisfies
meaning: What it designs or implements.

name: ID
meaning: The domain's ID and the flow's number.

name: Carries out
meaning: The use cases it carries out.

name: Uses
meaning: The views and endpoints it passes through.

name: Step
meaning: The step's record.

name: Flow
meaning: The flow it is a step of.

name: Order
meaning: Its place in the flow.
type: Whole number, unique in the flow.

name: Uses
meaning: The views, endpoints or components it goes through.

name: Fulfills
meaning: The requirements and rules it carries out, all inside its flow.

name: ID
meaning: The domain's ID and the view's number.

name: Route
meaning: Where it is, if it has an address.

name: Fulfills
meaning: The requirements it carries out.

name: ID
meaning: The domain's ID and the endpoint's number.

name: Method and route
meaning: How it is called.
type: An HTTP method and a path.

name: API
meaning: The API of the resource it serves, when the domain groups its endpoints.

name: Fulfills
meaning: The requirements it carries out.

name: ID
meaning: The domain's ID and the test's number.

name: Type and state
meaning: What sort of test it is, and whether it is automated, manual or planned.

name: Run by
meaning: The file that runs an automated test.
type: File path under the product root.

name: Proves and supports
meaning: What it is proof of, and what it backs without proving.

name: ID
meaning: The product's or domain's ID and the question's number.

name: Owner
meaning: The role that decides it.

name: About
meaning: The records it concerns.

name: ID
meaning: The domain's ID and the API's number.

name: Title
meaning: The resource it serves.

name: Shapes
meaning: The request and response shapes its endpoints share.

name: ID
meaning: The domain's ID and the integration's number.

name: System
meaning: The outside system it exchanges with.

name: Exchanges
meaning: What passes each way, one interaction requirement each.

name: ID
meaning: The domain's ID and the technical flow's number.

name: Deepens
meaning: The flow it carries out.

name: Failure, limits and signals
meaning: What can go wrong, the limits it keeps and what it reports.
example: A check whose SQL fails is an error naming its file

name: Step
meaning: The step's record.

name: Order and path
meaning: Its place on its path of the technical flow.
type: Whole number, unique on the path; a short path name.

name: Uses
meaning: The component that does it.

name: Satisfies
meaning: The obligations it designs.

name: Transaction, locks and statements
meaning: The transaction it runs in, what it locks and how many statements it runs.

name: Name
meaning: The check's name, the key of its row across Lathe's checks and every product's.
type: Text in lower case with hyphens, unique.

name: Product
meaning: The product a product's own check belongs to; none for Lathe's checks.

name: Position
meaning: When it runs: Lathe's checks in position order, then the product's own.

name: Severity
meaning: What its problems are: errors, warnings, or either when its query says which for each row.

name: Summary
meaning: What it asks, in one sentence.
example: An obligation that no automated or manual test proves yet.

name: Explanation
meaning: What it reports, what it leaves to other checks, and how to fix what it reports.
example: A test proves an obligation through a `proof` link…

name: Query
meaning: The one SELECT that finds its problems, returning `record` and `message`, and `severity` when its rows say which.
example: SELECT DISTINCT i.id AS record, … FROM coverage_item i WHERE NOT i.proved

name: Kinds
meaning: The kinds it concerns.
type: List of kind names; none for any kind.

name: Severity
meaning: Whether the workspace is broken or has work still to do.

name: Check
meaning: The check that found it, by name (`check_name`).

name: Record
meaning: The record it is about.
type: Record reference, or none for the whole workspace.

name: Message
meaning: What is wrong, and the fix.
example: No test proves interaction requirement TL-LEND-E06-R03 yet: its test is only planned.

name: Product
meaning: The product the limit is for.

name: Max children
meaning: The limit, the product's `product_setting.max_children`.
type: Whole number, at least 1; 15 when the product has no row.

name: Parent
meaning: The record whose children are counted.

name: Kind
meaning: The kind of children counted; tests are never counted.

name: Count
meaning: How many it holds.

name: Too many
meaning: Whether the count is over the limit.

name: Lone child
meaning: Whether a capability or layer holds exactly one child.

name: Address
meaning: Where the page is, to bookmark, share or reload.
type: Path, with the view as a query parameter.

name: Page kind
meaning: What sort of place it is.
type: Products, product, domain, record, group, checks or format.

name: Focus
meaning: The product, domain or record the page is about.

name: Group kind
meaning: On a group page, the kind of the focus's children shown.

name: View
meaning: How the focus is shown; it never changes the path.

name: Product
meaning: The product the space is.

name: Icon
meaning: What the rail shows.
type: Derived: the product's own icon, or its ID as a monogram.

name: Color
meaning: The icon's color.
type: Derived: the product's own color, or one derived from its ID.
example: Derived from TL, which gives no color

name: Place
meaning: Its place in the rail, which Alt and its number opens.
type: Derived whole number, in the products' ID order.

name: Last page
meaning: The last page visited in the space, for this browser session only.

name: Section
meaning: The folder of the meta-model it shows.

name: Domain
meaning: The domain whose records it holds.

name: Label
meaning: The name shown.

name: Folded
meaning: Whether it is folded in the navigation, for this browser session.

name: Group
meaning: What its tests prove.
type: Acceptance tests, domain rule tests, pattern tests, interaction tests, UI tests, design checks or engineering checks.

name: Order
meaning: Its place in the folder.

name: Label
meaning: The name shown, naming kinds through their plural.

name: Tests
meaning: How many tests it holds; an empty group is not shown.

name: Page
meaning: The page the graph is a view of.

name: Mode
meaning: Whether it reads along the parent and child tree, or along the trace from rule to test.

name: Depth
meaning: How far from the focus it reaches.

name: Hidden kinds
meaning: Kinds the filters hide; never the focus's own.

name: Hidden relations
meaning: Relations the filters hide, with the paths through them.

name: Record
meaning: The record drawn.

name: Column
meaning: Its depth in the parent and child tree around the focus, shared with its siblings.

name: Distance
meaning: How many hops it is from the focus.

name: Parent
meaning: The record whose children it holds.

name: Kind
meaning: The kind of the children.

name: Count
meaning: How many children it holds.

name: Open
meaning: Whether its members are drawn.

name: From
meaning: The node or group the line starts at.

name: To
meaning: The node or group the line ends at.

name: Relation
meaning: What the line stands for.
type: A relation from the meta-model, or parent and child.

name: Space
meaning: The space whose tabs these are.

name: Tabs
meaning: The open tabs, left to right.
type: Ordered list of tabs, never empty.

name: Active tab
meaning: The tab shown, whose page the address names.

name: Page
meaning: The page it holds, by its address path.

name: Preview
meaning: Whether the next plain open replaces it.
type: Yes or no; at most one tab of a group says yes.

name: Views
meaning: The views it has open, those its page does not offer included.

name: Pane sizes
meaning: Each pane's weight, which the gaps share out.

name: Wiki scroll
meaning: How far down the wiki pane was.

name: Graph settings
meaning: The graph's depth, trace, filters and open groups.
type: Depth 1 to 3, yes or no, kinds and relations hidden, groups open.

name: Data folder
meaning: Where the product's data files were read from, as `lathe.config.json` names it.
type: Folder path, relative to the root.

name: Refusals
meaning: The rows the store refused on load, each with its file, line and rule; while there are any, nothing else is checked.
type: List of store problems, or none.

name: Errors
meaning: How many problems are errors.

name: Panel
meaning: Which part of the page it is.
type: Navigation, wiki pane, graph pane or side bar.

name: Shown
meaning: Whether it is on screen; a hidden panel keeps a control that brings it back.

name: Command ID
meaning: The command's name in the keymap.

name: Title
meaning: What it does, as the palette and the shortcuts sheet show it.

name: Group
meaning: Where the shortcuts sheet lists it.

name: Context
meaning: Where it applies.
type: Anywhere, on a page, while the graph shows, or in a list.

name: Handled by
meaning: Who acts on its keys.
type: The app, the component it belongs to, or the browser.

name: Keys
meaning: The chord, or chords in sequence, as the keymap writes them.
type: Text: a chord such as Mod+Shift+P, or chords separated by spaces.

name: Override
meaning: The person's own binding in its place, if any.

name: On a Mac
meaning: How a Mac shows it.

name: Elsewhere
meaning: How other platforms show it.

name: ARIA name
meaning: What `aria-keyshortcuts` says.
type: Derived: DOM modifier names, or none for a sequence.

name: Where
meaning: Where the hint is shown.
type: Tooltip, palette row, sheet row, `aria-keyshortcuts` or placeholder.

name: Shows
meaning: The binding as the platform shows it.

name: Name
meaning: What the theme is called.
type: Text, unique among the person's themes.

name: Built in
meaning: Whether Lathe ships it, so it is never changed.

name: Light and dark tokens
meaning: The colors for each color mode.
type: Two maps from token name to value.

name: Shared tokens
meaning: Type, shape, density and motion, for both modes.
type: Map from token name to value.

name: Role
meaning: What sort of control it is.

name: Name
meaning: What a screen reader calls it, holding its visible text.

name: Target
meaning: The size it can be hit at.
type: Pixels, at least 24 or with room around it.

name: Keys
meaning: The shortcut that runs it, if any.

name: Folder
meaning: The product folder it shows.

name: Bounds
meaning: Its saved size and place.
type: x, y, width and height in screen points.

name: Server
meaning: Where it loads Lathe from.

name: Folder
meaning: The folder.

name: Opened
meaning: When it was last opened, which orders the list.

name: Source
meaning: Which server it is.
type: `serve()` in the shell, a Vite dev server the shell starts, or the shared 5199 dev server.

name: Folder
meaning: The product folder it reads.

name: Port
meaning: Where it answers.
type: Port number, never 5199 for one the shell starts.

name: Commands
meaning: What the write does, in order.
type: List of commands, at least one.

name: Tables changed
meaning: The tables whose rows the write changed.

name: Files rewritten
meaning: The data files rewritten for those tables, and no others.

name: Operation
meaning: What the command does.

name: Target
meaning: The row it acts on: a table and a row, a record ID or a part row by its key, or a relation and its two ends.
type: Table and key, or relation and IDs.

name: Values
meaning: The columns it sets or clears, or the record's new parent for a move.
type: Map from column name to value, null clearing one.

name: Rule
meaning: The constraint or validation query the data broke.

name: Message
meaning: What is wrong, naming the table, row and value.
example: view TL-LEND-V02: domain_id "TL-NOPE" names no domain

name: Where
meaning: The data file and line of a row that was loaded, or the index of the command that brought it.
type: File and line, or command number from 0.

name: Domain
meaning: The domain counted.

name: Automated tests
meaning: The domain's tests that run as code.

name: Manual tests
meaning: The domain's tests a person carries out.

name: Planned tests
meaning: The domain's tests not written yet.

name: Kind
meaning: The obligation kind counted.

name: Total
meaning: How many the domain owes.

name: Designed
meaning: How many a design link targets.

name: Built
meaning: How many a component whose file exists designs.

name: Proved
meaning: How many an automated or manual test proves.

name: Planned
meaning: How many are not proved but a planned test is meant to prove.

name: Still owed
meaning: How many a planned test is meant to prove, proved or not.

name: Obligation
meaning: The obligation with the gap.

name: Kind
meaning: The obligation's kind.

name: Missing
meaning: What it lacks.

name: Test
meaning: The test that makes the claim.

name: Obligation
meaning: What it claims to prove.

name: Relation
meaning: The link that makes the claim.

name: Test state
meaning: Whether the test runs as code, is carried out by a person, or is not written yet.

name: File
meaning: The file that runs or carries out the test: its `file`, or its `key_file` when it names one.
type: File path from the product root; optional for a manual or planned test.

name: Backed by
meaning: What in the file backs the claim.
type: Derived: the test's own ID, every ID it proves, its key, or nothing.

name: Counts in
meaning: The domains whose coverage counts the claim.
type: Derived list of domains, or none.

name: Follower
meaning: The domain or use case that follows the pattern.

name: Pattern
meaning: The pattern followed.

name: Domain
meaning: The domain that owes the pattern's rules because of it.

name: Setting
meaning: The pattern's setting.
type: A setting its pattern lists (a `pattern_setting` name).

name: Value
meaning: What the setting is for this follower: its `value`, or why it does not apply (`not_applicable`).
example: The member's name and a valid email address.

name: Pattern rule
meaning: The rule owed.

name: Applies
meaning: Whether the domain owes it: not when every following use case gives its setting a not-applicable reason, nor when it is waived because no follower meets its applies-when setting.
